description: This file defines the interface for reflog walk operations within a version control system, including initialization, release, message retrieval, and iteration over reflog entries.

methods.name: reflog_walk_info_release
methods.description: Release resources associated with reflog walk information.

methods.name: add_reflog_for_walk
methods.description: Add a reflog entry for a specific commit to the walk context.

methods.name: show_reflog_message
methods.description: Display the reflog message with options for date formatting and forcing display.

methods.name: get_reflog_message
methods.description: Retrieve the reflog message into a buffer.

methods.name: get_reflog_ident
methods.description: Get the identifier associated with the reflog.

methods.name: get_reflog_timestamp
methods.description: Retrieve the timestamp of the reflog entry.

methods.name: get_reflog_selector
methods.description: Generate a selector string for filtering reflog entries based on date and display options.

methods.name: reflog_walk_empty
methods.description: Check if there are more reflog entries to walk.

methods.name: next_reflog_entry
methods.description: Get the next reflog entry in the walk.
